edits.reason: Trasladar al artículo las reglas de provisionalidad y denominador cero que ya contiene la ficha.
edits.before: In practice, records may be incomplete and sales can take time. Keep recent enquiries with unresolved outcomes separate rather than treating them as lost or combining them with customers from older campaigns.
edits.after: In practice, records may be incomplete and sales can take time. Keep recent enquiries with unresolved outcomes separate rather than treating them as lost or combining them with customers from older campaigns. Label an unresolved group as provisional and record the reporting cut-off and follow-up period. If a denominator is zero, report that measure as unavailable.
